A deadly shooting in the suburbs of Paris, France, has left one person dead and at least five others injured, including a 12-year-old girl. French authorities are investigating the incident as a suspected racially motivated terrorist attack.The shootings took place at three locations in Trappes and La Verrière, west of Paris. French President Emmanuel Macron condemned the incident, describing it as a “racist terror attack” and warning against the rise of racist ideologies.
